logic.note: Off below 2 V in, boosting to vout, passing the input through (minus ~0.4 V) when the input is above vout.

timing.note: Settles instantly with each re-solve: no soft-start, no ripple, no transient response.

analog.note: Output vout with 0.05 Ω output resistance; input current = vout × Iout / (0.88 × VIN) + 1 mA, so a sagging battery draws more. Real efficiency is 80 to 93 % depending on load and input.

power.note: Warns when the switch current (about the input current) passes 2 A or the input passes 24 V; no current limit or thermal shutdown.

emulates: 5 V (or any vout) from a 1S LiPo
Battery current from output power and efficiency
doesNotEmulate: Output ripple and switching noise (a problem for ADC readings and audio)
The trimmer's real setting: check it with a meter
testOnRealDevice: Set the trimmer to vout with a meter before connecting the load
Ripple on the 5 V rail if analog readings jump
